images.title: Auckland Regional Council offices on Pitt Street, 2007
images.creator: Ingolfson
images.description: The former Auckland Regional Council building on Pitt Street, photographed from Nelson Street.

association.relationship: This photograph shows the former Auckland Regional Council offices in 2007; it does not depict the council's GIS software or operations.

images.title: Upper Hutt Civic Centre administration building and council chambers, 2005
images.creator: Michael Dudding (Allthenamesaretaken)
images.description: Upper Hutt civic administration building and council chambers, photographed in 2005.

association.relationship: A photograph of the council's civic facilities in 2005, after the first XPLORER mapping service; it is not an image of XPLORER.

images.title: Lower Hutt Town Hall and council administration building, 2021

images.description: Lower Hutt Town Hall, clock tower and council administration building.

images.title: Christchurch City Council civic offices on Hereford Street, 2019
images.creator: Roger 8 Roger
images.description: Hereford Street entrance to the Christchurch City Council office complex, formerly the mail sorting centre and occupied by the council since 2010.

association.relationship: Council office exterior photographed in 2019, not an illustration of the council's early geospatial technology.

images.title: Royal New Zealand Air Force aerial reconnaissance of Christchurch earthquake damage, 2011
images.creator: New Zealand Defence Force / RNZAF
images.description: Aerial reconnaissance image taken by an RNZAF P-3K Orion showing earthquake damage near New Brighton Road, Pages Road, Hawke Street and Owles Terrace, Christchurch.

association.relationship: Contemporary NZDF aerial surveillance of the Christchurch earthquake damage on 22 February 2011; documents response imagery, not the subsequent web mapping application.

images.title: Copernicus Sentinel image of Cyclone Gabrielle flooding near Napier, 2023
images.creator: Pierre Markuse; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2023]
images.captured: 14–15 February 2023 (scene labelled 14 February; Commons records upload-source timestamp 15 February)
images.licence: CC BY 2.0 with required Copernicus Sentinel attribution
images.description: Satellite-derived depiction of flooding near Napier after Cyclone Gabrielle, approximately 25 km across. Attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2023], processed by Pierre Markuse.

association.relationship: Appropriate only once a distinct, evidence-backed Cyclone Gabrielle mapping event is identified or created in the historical dataset; do not assign to the 2011 Christchurch event.

images.title: Former Auckland City Council civic administration building, 2007
images.creator: Ingolfson
images.description: Former Auckland City Council Civic Building close to Aotea Square, shown in 2007; predecessor to the post-2010 unitary council.

association.relationship: The former Auckland City Council offices, not current Auckland Council headquarters. Confirm the exact historical record before association.
